newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Village in Warner Euro cinema venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Village in Warner Euro cinema venture.

text.p: Village Roadshow Ltd said on Tuesday it would spend A$170 million to buy 50 percent of Warner Brothers chain cinemas in the United Kingdom and Germany.
Warner Brothers, a unit of Time Warner, will hold the other 50 percent.

Village said the A$170 million investment represents a valuation by directors of 50 percent of 15 UK operating cinema sites and three German operating cinema sites of A$163 million and an at cost contribution for working capital on 12 existing development sites of about A$7 million.
It said it is envisaged that 50 perent of the purchase price would be funded by loan facilities from the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd with the balance from cash reserves.
In addition, Village Roadshow would contribute an additional A$60 million for new multiplexes ever the next three years.
Warner Brothers currently operates 143 screens on 16 sites in the United Kingdom, and 26 screens within three locations in the Ruhr Valley of Germany, Village said.
When completion occurs at the end of November 1996 those theatres will become owned and operated by the joint venture, it said.
Warner Brothers and Village currently operate 19 cinemas with 160 screens as well as theme parks in Australia.
Village shares closed steady at A$5.00 on Monday.
